author: Stream B (Śāstra)
supersedes: GOCHARA_TEST_ORACLES_v1_0.json (25 entries against 35 spec-named — review finding F1/S-07)
count_rule: this header's oracle_count must equal the length of oracles[] and the spec §11.2 index total; a mismatch is itself a defect

harness_contract.fields: id, guards, defects, given (literal fixture), when, then, mutation_that_must_fail, operands_source, tolerance
harness_contract.n8_rule: an oracle that cannot fail is rejected at review; every oracle here carries a mutation that must fail it
harness_contract.worked_events: the three §11.3 events are development cases — calibrate here, never scored in the evaluation protocol

constants.natal_precision_note: Venus 259.1882 rounds half-up to 259.19 at 2 dp (v1.0's 259.17 was wrong — S-08). DMS displays truncate to the arcsecond.
constants.sign_of: floor(lambda/30): 0 Aries … 11 Pisces; house counted inclusively from the frame sign

oracles.given: target point at longitude 0°00′ (Aries 0°); Mars as aspecting body; forward count: Mars 4th aspect falls at (λ_mars + 90°) mod 360, so contact with target 0° requires λ_mars = (0 − 90) mod 360 = 270°
oracles.when: Mars special-aspect contacts are solved for the 0° target
oracles.then: Mars at 270°00′ (Capricorn 0°) produces a 4th-aspect contact; Mars at 90°00′ produces NO 4th-aspect contact (that is the mirrored defect)
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: implementation computing aspect target as target + 90° (the shipped mirror) reports a contact for Mars at 90° and misses Mars at 270° — must fail both assertions

oracles.given: target 0°00′; Mars 8th aspect at (λ + 210°) mod 360 ⇒ λ_mars = 150°
oracles.then: Mars at 150°00′ (Virgo 0°) produces the 8th-aspect contact; Mars at 210° does not
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: mirrored direction (210° instead of 150°) must fail

oracles.given: target 0°00′; Saturn 3rd aspect at (λ + 60°) mod 360 ⇒ λ_saturn = 300°
oracles.then: Saturn at 300°00′ (Aquarius 0°) produces the 3rd-aspect contact; Saturn at 60° does not
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: mirrored direction must fail

oracles.given: target 0°00′; Saturn 10th aspect at (λ + 270°) mod 360 ⇒ λ_saturn = 90°
oracles.then: Saturn at 90°00′ (Gemini 0°) produces the 10th-aspect contact; Saturn at 270° does not
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: mirrored direction must fail

oracles.given: natal Moon 327.06° → floor(327.06/30)=10 → Aquarius; transit Jupiter 2022-01-03 306.87° → floor(306.87/30)=10 → Aquarius; count from Aquarius inclusive: Aquarius=1st
oracles.when: records are built for the twins event

oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: a build emitting the 5th-from-Moon record, or omitting the lagna-frame record, fails

oracles.given: frame bhavat_bhavam:9 (9th from Aries = Sagittarius); 7th from 9th = Gemini (Mercury); 8th from 9th = Cancer (Moon); 2nd from 9th = Capricorn (Saturn)
oracles.then: MD lord Mercury and AD lord Moon resolve as father-frame relationship records (7th-from-9th and 8th-from-9th lords); agent Saturn is 2nd-from-9th lord; relationship-existence assertion is separate from any scoring-permission assertion (testimony stays testimony)
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: records resolved in the native's lagna or Moon frame instead of bhavat_bhavam:9 fail

oracles.given: natal Saturn 202.43° → Libra = 7th sign from Aries; pinned natal fixture from L1 build 1c092ffb
oracles.then: natal Saturn appears with object_role=occupant of the 7th house in the emitted record set; a run resolving only 7L Venus is a recorded miss
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: an object set containing only the lord, or occupant at a different longitude, fails

oracles.given: fixture with one negative sensitive fact (value_text='not_gandanta') and one positive sensitive fact (a real degree) per E3's shape
oracles.then: no object from the negative fact; the positive fact DOES produce its object; the negative fact attaches only as a graha qualifier
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: dropping the positive object, or materialising the negative one, fails (no vacuous pass on an empty record set)

oracles.given: a cited yoga→event relation fixture (e.g. a named 7th-house combination with a declared class), with a cancellation condition and a strength operand, both pinned
oracles.when: records are enumerated for the yoga's class
oracles.then: the record exists with the yoga as object_role=yoga_constituent, its strength consumed as a named factor, and the cancellation condition evaluated (false here); a second fixture with the cancellation true produces NO admission
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: an implementation ignoring the cancellation, or the strength operand, fails

oracles.given: fixture A: named afflicter (Saturn) conjunct object X within the declared orb; fixture B: same object, no afflicter contact
oracles.then: A ⇒ afflicted=true with the afflicter named; B ⇒ afflicted=false; an unevaluated fixture ⇒ unqualified, not false
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: label-based affliction (string match) or afflicted-by-default fails

oracles.given: a window whose record set includes a testimony row (e.g. a māraka edge), with a pinned score
oracles.when: the window is scored with the testimony row present vs removed
oracles.then: scores are identical; the row's annotation is present in the breakdown in both its content fields
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: any score delta from adding/removing a testimony row fails

oracles.given: a window admitted by P3 with P2's Moon-frame phala adverse at the same instant (literal fixture: P3 lagna-frame contact present; P2 adverse residence row present)
oracles.then: the window REMAINS admitted (union); the P2 record attaches as evidence_against_occurrence on the native's own-fortune class only; no cascade exclusion occurs
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: a cascade implementation (P2 adverse vetoes the P3 window) fails

oracles.given: 2018-11-28 Jupiter 220.31° → Scorpio; Jupiter's aspects from Scorpio: 5th=Pisces, 7th=Taurus, 9th=Cancer (specials full); father frame = Sagittarius ∉ {Pisces,Taurus,Cancer}
oracles.when: P4 records are sought for the father frame on 2018-11-28
oracles.then: NO P4 record; admission runs on P3+P1; any P4 row for this frame-date is a regression
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: a P4 row on 2018-11-28 fails

oracles.given: 2022-01-03 Jupiter 306.87° (Aquarius) 7th-aspects Leo (5th house); Saturn 288.01° vs natal Sun 291.96° (5L): Δ = 3.95° = 3°57′; admission orb for P4 pinned at 5° (candidate: inside 5° admits; a 1°-orb candidate would not)

oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: endpoint-only peak detection, or admission requiring BOTH house and lord contacts, fails
oracles.tolerance: Δ to the arcminute; orb pinned in the fixture

oracles.given: BPHS ch.46 conditions: Rāhu in kendra/trikoṇa from lagna lord (Mars 198.52° Libra; Rāhu 49.03° Taurus = 8th from Libra — FAILS); pakṣa condition (day birth, Śukla — fails the Kṛṣṇa reading; OCR-degraded clause recorded per CORPUS_READS §6)
oracles.when: permission is computed at any instant
oracles.then: Aṣṭottarī reports absent with both failed conditions named; no Aṣṭottarī vote in any union
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: an Aṣṭottarī vote appearing, or absence reported without the failed conditions, fails

oracles.given: Sade-Sati phase 1 at 2022-01-03: Moon Aquarius; Saturn 288.01° → Capricorn = 12th from Aquarius (count written). This is the SAME test in spec prose and here — v1.0's prose/JSON divergence is the reviewed defect
oracles.then: the Saturn-12th-from-Moon residence contributes evidence_FOR_occurrence to adverse classes (adverse residence is evidence for adverse classes — D-RQ5 shape); it attaches NOTHING to the childbirth (gain) class; the testimony row exists only on adverse-eligible classes
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: attaching the edge to childbirth, or recording it as evidence_against on an adverse class (the v1.0 prose error), must fail

oracles.given: a path whose promise term = strength × condition; fixture with strength > 0 and condition true, and the same fixture with condition set false
oracles.then: condition true ⇒ promise = strength value; condition false ⇒ promise = 0; a constant-presence implementation (promise = strength regardless) fails the second case
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: condition-independent promise fails

oracles.given: P1 fixture: period lord transiting sign S evaluated as exaltation; the same fixture with S's dignity operand flipped to debilitation
oracles.then: the qualifier flips sign (promotion → misery) per the declared factor effect; every factor in the P1 inventory has a declared effect row
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: dignity-independent qualifier fails

oracles.given: a chart fixture whose qualified restrictions (transit_triggers / dasha_rules) name a specific (agent, relation, target) set
oracles.then: only the qualified set is enumerated; a Cartesian all-agents × all-targets enumeration produces extra rows and fails the count

oracles.given: a bereavement-class window admitted by P3 (father frame: Saturn 253.43° vs natal Jupiter 249.79° 9L: Δ = 3.64° = 3°38′24″, in the 9th)
oracles.then: evidence_for_occurrence > 0 AND outcome_valence_for_native = adverse; the all-favourable era table (E5) is the regression
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: outcome favourable, or evidence zeroed, fails

oracles.given: the 2013-12 marriage window: P3+P4 evidence for occurrence (7th-occupant Saturn return, Jupiter 5th aspect on Libra) AND evidence against occurrence (natal 7th affliction condition) both > 0
oracles.then: evidence_for and evidence_against BOTH stand (occurrence contested, reported as such); outcome_valence_for_native = favourable (marriage class polarity) — NOT 'mixed': contested occurrence does not relabel outcome valence
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: netting the two evidence fields to neutral, or deriving mixed from contested occurrence, fails

oracles.given: a window whose AV operand is unresolved (no pinned L1 AV extract)
oracles.then: valence contribution = unqualified and the window breakdown names the unresolved operand; no silent 1.0 and no favourable default
oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: a silent default (1.0 or 'favourable') fails

oracles.given: L1 chart_dashas (Vimśottarī, nested ≥3 levels)
oracles.when: permission context is computed at the three event instants
oracles.then: 2013-12-11 → MD Mercury / AD Ketu with the PD lord asserted exactly; 2018-11-28 → Mercury/Moon + PD; 2022-01-03 → Mercury/Rāhu + PD — a constant or absent PD fails

oracles.when: permission(class=marriage, t) is evaluated inside each period and at the boundary

oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: constant permission across the two periods fails; variance-only conformance (the v1.0 test) is recorded as insufficient, not run as the oracle

oracles.given: chart operands: Rāhu 8th from lagna lord Mars; day birth Śukla pakṣa

oracles.mutation_that_must_fail: absent-without-reasons, or a weighted vote, fails

oracles.given: an evaluation instant where the vedha overlay was never computed (no coverage row)
